Wine-Glass Revolution

Read `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\profile.csv` and revolve the 20 sampled `(r_mm, z_mm)` points around the world Z axis with 72 segments, then save the result as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\answer.skp`.

Ensure that the OBJ parses, has about `19 * 72 * 2` faces (+/-100), stays 72-fold rotationally symmetric within 2 mm after a 5 deg rotation, spans about `0.252 m` in Z (+/-3 mm), and has a top rim radius of about `40 mm` (+/-5 mm).
source: Chopra — SketchUp For Dummies (Follow Me); COLLADA/OBJ revolution primitives
